items.headline: Patriots' A.J. Brown has career-high 3 dropped passes in return from injury
items.description: Patriots receiver A.J. Brown, coming off a right high ankle sprain that sidelined him four weeks, had a shaky return to action Sunday, dropping a career-high three passes in the team's win over the Jets
